messages:
Alex B: Heads-up: Sprint-42 deploy window today 15:00 UTC. Rolling canary across 3 replica sets, then full. Need gatekeepers for lanes A/B/C. Smoke checklist below — please ack if you can take a lane.

Alex B: Smoke checklist (short):
- KV cache warmup
- Run perf probe (p50/p90/p99)
- Quick auth walkthrough (+login flow)
- Console sanity (no missing metrics)
- Confirm rollback tags exist

Priya S: I can take lane A (auth & routing). Will be ready for smoke at +5m after canary.

Dan L: Taking lane B (inference runtime). Will validate model-serving pipeline and perf. I'll run: `./deploy/smoke.sh --target lane-b --concurrency 20` and post results.

Maria T: I'll gate lane C (console + metrics). Rollback tags are pre-created: r42-2024-06-18-01 and r42-2024-06-18-02.

DeployBot: Deploy job queued: job id dj-1745054321, ETA 15:00 UTC. Status: scheduled.

Alex B: For the smoke please run the KV warmup then these checks: `curl -fsS https://api.redwood.internal/health` and `redis-cli --raw info | grep used_memory`. If p90 latency > 120ms or any 5xx, abort and tag rollback. Post a 1-line summary.

SRE Oncall: I'll watch infra dashboards (latency, 5xx, GPU memory). Alerts set at +50% baseline. I'll post 'SRE: all clear' after 2m stable. @Priya S @Dan L @Maria T

Dan L: Canary smoke completed on canary-1: p50=80ms p90=95ms p99=110ms, no 5xx, GPU mem stable. KV warmup looked good. Moving to canary-2.

Priya S: :thumbsup: noted. Small FYI — one flaky e2e in staging around SSO but not seen in canary auth checks. Not blocking.

Maria T: Console and metrics look normal from canary-1. Dashboards reporting expected event rates. Rollback tags verified. Ready to gate full rollout when Dan gives the go.

Dan L: Canary-2 smoke green. Rolling to full in 10m.

Alex B: Proceeding with full rollout now. Marking this thread as deploy-in-progress. If anything goes sideways, rollback with `git tag r42-2024-06-18-02` + revert job and ping #eng-oncall.

SRE Oncall: SRE: all clear after 2m during full rollout. Watching for 15m window.

Dan L: Full rollout finished. No regressions observed. Will keep monitoring for 30m.

Maria T: All clear from console. Closing my gate.

Alex B: Thanks team — rollout complete. If any post-deploy regressions appear, reopen this thread.
